notes: Fixes to the Z.ai sign-in screen reported on v1.0.19. Tapping "Sign in to Z.ai" could land on the chat.z.ai home page instead of the login form (Android WebView requests are treated differently by the site), which made logging in impossible - now the sheet detects that state and automatically opens the sidebar and taps "Sign in" for you, driven by updatable selectors, and if anything is still unclear a hint line tells you exactly what to tap. The sheet now checks every 2 seconds whether the login succeeded: it closes by itself and the card shows Connected (also when you close it right after logging in). The current page URL is shown in a small debug line while the sheet is open, and the site's verification puzzle stays fully solvable inside the sheet. Sign-in now presents a Chrome-style browser identity so Google logins are not rejected with "disallowed_useragent" (Google OAuth verified reachable from the probe; your device is the final judge). Fixed: the Claude Code tab and the Z.ai tab were highlighted at the same time - only the selected tab is highlighted now. Three CLI agents and all settings untouched; same signing key - installs over v1.0.19 with one tap.
